boundary: If the address had been private (not self-published in a public bio) and the area had multiple engines, Operational plus Privacy could fit; with a public address and a single-engine roster, a false dispatch is a safety harm.
factor: unverified emergency dispatch tying up a scarce emergency resource; already-public personal data
note: The unsupported claim that passing the self-published home address to responders is a privacy exposure produced the wrong second label; the missed single-engine roster fact would have supported Physical / Health instead.
